scope: Eight original issuers, gross continuous dimensionless index, June 2014 to June 2026. Directed event repair, not universal certification of distributions.

selection.source: bh_selection_2014.csv; bh_ranking_2014.csv; inherited market_cap_2014.csv and PIT FRE/FCA extracts
selection.unquoted_classes: Use last observed historical ON quote; if no observed ON quote, use PN proxy. Sensitivity doubles these ON prices and leaves eight selected names unchanged. This is a convention, not proof of an absolute valuation bound.
selection.multiple_pn_classes: Inherited aggregate PN valuation remains an approximation for nonleaders with multiple preferred classes; selected leaders do not require that approximation.
selection.hypermarcas: Historical mixed business classified by predominant 2013 revenue, not by modern Hypera profile.
selection.hypermarcas_release: originals/hypera_2013_release.pdf.gz, dated 2014-02-21, pages 1 and 3; total revenue 4258.7 million, Farma about 2300 million. The later API publication timestamp reflects migration, not historical availability.

TBLE3_EGIE3: originals/engie_bonus_2018_doe.pdf.gz, original DOE SC 2018-12-10 page 34; explicit 1:4, record 2018-12-11, ex 2018-12-12

bradesco_2017: Record 2017-04-28 in official remuneration table; next session 2017-05-02 is ex. Do not use secondary 2017-04-28 ex-date.
radl_2023: Issuer AGM notice dated 2023-04-19 expressly gives record 2023-05-19, ex 2023-05-22. Approval date alone is not ex-date. B3 auction notice independently confirms ratio 1:25.
renames: TBLE3 -> EGIE3 on 2016-07-21, same issuer and ON class
CCRO3 -> MOTV3 on 2025-05-02, same issuer and ON class

cemig_right.convention: Detach old entitlement, retain right until first traded close, convert into parent index units. No external subscription funding.

xp_spinoff.convention: Both ITUB4 and XPBR31 remain held. COTAHIST closes replace the incomplete SQLite XP series after October 2022.

xp_fx_convention: USD per BDR multiplied by ex-date PTAX venda, frozen BCB original responses in originals/xp_gross_ptax.json. Reinvest in XPBR31 at that local close. Gross theoretical return: no taxes, depositary fees or operational settlement simulation. First USD 0.58 uses issuer rounded announcement precision.
hypermarcas_private_issues: 2014 private capital increase exchanged Cosmed shares; later small increases relate to employee options. No free entitlement for existing HYPE3 holders.
ccr_2017: Public offering at bookbuilding price, not a bonus. No automatically credited free shares in the index.
